summary.text: Wes Enos is the Republican candidate for Iowa State Senate District 23 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Anthony Thompson.
Ballotpedia lists him as having lost the June 2 Republican primary to incumbent Mike Bousselot, who is listed as a withdrawn or disqualified candidate for the general election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia says Enos was also a candidate in the 2010 Republican primary for Iowa State Senate, in which he and Michael Adams Jr. were defeated by Joe Pirillo.
In the 2026 primary, Bousselot received 64.9 percent of the vote to Enos's 34.8 percent.
